home.title: {{app}}tti si simanna
home.tagline: Hawaasni tokko gara manaatti deebi'ee fayyaa ta'ee jiraachuuf.

wellbeing.roughHelp: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.locksHelp: Feesbuukii tokko torban tokkoof, torban lamaaf, ji'a tokkoof, yookiin barabaraaf cufaa. Rakkoo, gargaarsi deebi'ee dhufuu, qunnamtii bilbilaa nageenya qabuu fi qulqulleessuun odeeffannoo yoomiyyuu cufuu hin danda'u.

community.noPhone: Lakkoofsi bilbilaa ergaa walfakkaatu irratti hin mulʼatu.

support.resourcesNote: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.
support.meetingsTitle: Walga'iiwwan tarkaanfiiwwan kudha lamaa fi deebisanii ijaaruu

safety.relapseDraft: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.safeContactsHelp: Qajeelchituu ykn nama bilbila nageenyaa bilbiluu wajjin walitti dhufeenya cimaa qabaadhu.
safety.vaultHelp: Your documents are encrypted. Paid plan feature; no price has been set yet.
safety.wipeHelp: Kun dhugumaan odeeffannoo kee ni balleessa; deebi'ee deebisuu hin danda'u.
safety.wipeConfirm: Kun odeeffannoo koo akka na jalaa balleesse hubadheera.

reentry.noSteps: Tarkaanfiiwwan tarreeffaman hanga ammaatti hin kennamne.
reentry.tipsAnonymous: Gorsi hin kennamu. Lakkoofsi bilbilaas hin mulʼatu.
reentry.tipPlaceholder: Tarkaanfii kana fudhachuuf maaltu si gargaare?
reentry.crisisStep: Lakkoofsota kana amma galchi. Siʼayinaa dandeessa "Need help now" jedhu tuquun madda shaashii kamiyyuu gubbaa.
reentry.resourceOnly: Resource pointer only — Groundwork kana hin dhiyeessu ykn dhiyeessitoota waliin hin hojjetu.

steps.step5: Gara mana keetti deemuuf karoora baafadhu
steps.step7: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
steps.step8: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
steps.step9: Barreeffamoota gadhiisuu fi yeroon itti gadhiifaman ilaali
steps.step10: Guyyaa fi haala yeroo jalqabaatiif galmaa'uu kee mirkaneessi
steps.step13: Bilbila, e-meelii fi Intarneetii bilisaa argachuu
steps.step14: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
steps.step17: Check your fines, fees and restitution
steps.step19: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
steps.step24: Qorannoo qoricha sammuu nama hadoochu fudhachuu
steps.step27: Hojjettoota carraa lammataa argataniif iyyannoo dhiheessi
steps.step31: Maatii kee wajjin walitti dhufeenya uumuu fi yoo barbaachisaa taʼe qarshii daaʼima kunuunsuuf si barbaachisu dhiheessuu
steps.step33: Galma yeroo dheeraa tokko baafadhaa; galma guyyoota 90 keessatti galmeessitan kabajaa

work.paroleNote: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.

journey.portfolioPrivate: Akka bu'uuraatti dhuunfaadha. Yeroo filattu qofaan qooduu dandeessa.

venue.placeholder: Suuraaleen bakka dhugaan itti ta'e hin kennamne; kun bakka dhugaan miti.

family.help: Miseensonni maatiikee wanta itti himtu qofa argu.

readAloud.title: Sagalee ol kaasanii dubbisuu
readAloud.help: Dubbisni sagalee ol kaasu sagalee meeshaa kee fayyadamee sagalee ol kaasuun barreeffama dubbisa.

phase3.resumeHelp: Muuxannoo kee irratti hundaaʼuudhaan, seenaa jireenyaa salphaa taʼe tokko barreessi.
phase3.headline: Mata duree
phase3.interviewHelp: Leenjisaan kee dhibbaafi bu'aa tokko siif kenna.
phase3.gigsHelp: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.paidNote: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.geoHelp: Namoonni kaan magaalaakee qofa ni hubatu; bakki itti argamtu garuu hin beekamu.
phase3.rideHelp: Nama geessuu gaafadhu. Lakkoofsi bilbilaa hin mulʼatu. Bakka namoonni itti baayʼatanitti wal argaa.
phase3.partnersHelp: Gareewwan xixinnoo sadii taʼanii wal qunnaman.
phase3.caption: Caqasicha
phase3.qaHelp: Maqaa utuu hin beeksisin gaafadhu. Deebiin miseensota gara fuulduraarraa dhufa.
phase3.shareHelp: Kaardiin guddina kee argisiisu tokko ni lakkaaʼama.
phase3.archiveHelp: Barreeffamni kun guyyaa murteessaa taʼe tokkotti ni banama.
phase3.matchHelp: Abukaatoon kee dura abbootii taayitaa kaanii wajjin mariʼata.
phase3.datingOff: Seerri guyyoota muraasaaf turuu qabu hamma mirkanaaʼutti hiriyummaa dhaabuun hin dandaʼamu.
phase3.carpoolHelp: Bakka jalqaba itti ilaaltu. Opt-in, sadarkaa magaalaa qofa: eenyutu walga'ii keetti deemaa akka jiru ilaali fi ergaa appilikeeshinii keessa jiruun wal qunnamti. Lakkoofsa bilbilaa hin qabu, bakki sirriis hin jiru.
phase3.groupsHelp: Gareelee fayyinaa, gareelee deeggarsa deebi'anii galuu, akkasumas gareelee amantaa fi hawaasaa magaalaa fi sa'aatii walga'iitiin.
phase3.rideFallbackHelp: Yeroo namni bilbilaan si waliin deemu hin jirretti qofa kan mul'atu. Gaafii appilikeeshinii keessatti to'atame ergu — sadarkaa magaalaa qofa, lakkoofsa bilbilaa hin qabu.
phase3.noCarpoolMatch: Walga'ii kanaaf konkolaataan walfakkaatu waan hin jirreef, 'Needs a Ride' bakka bu'aa ta'ee agarsiifameera.
phase3.familyRideHelp: Konkolaachistoota hayyamamaniif qofa. Pingiin daqiiqaa 2'f yeroodhaan tokko tokkoon ni deema; qunnamtiin itti aanu osoo hin beeksifamin dura ni mirkaneessita.
phase3.pingConfirm: Pingii itti aanu erguu keessan dura mirkaneessaa
phase3.housingHelp: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.musicHelp: Muuziqaawwan fakkii qofa. Seenaawwan tamsa'anii hin jiran. Taphachiisaan kun moodeelota akademii fi barnootaa keessatti ni cufama.
phase3.musicOffAcademy: Yommuu kutaa barnootaa keessa jirtan muuziqaan hin jiru.
phase3.visLink: (Walitti hidhamuu hin danda'u, deebi'uu hin danda'u)
phase3.shareWho: Yeroo ammaa: si qofa. Liinkii maxxansuun namni liinkii qabu kamiyyuu akka dubbisu godha.
phase3.suggestHelp: Gorsa qofa — hanga itti hin dabalinitti wanti maxxanfamu hin jiru.

crisisReply.onlyYou: Ergaa kana si qofatu arguu dandaʼa.
crisisReply.openCrisis: Buttuu rakkoo fi bilbila nageenyaa banuu
